decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal, because of its design and appearance, is considered acceptable as it would relate well to its site and would not harm either the appearance of the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours and would comply with the Council's parking standards. The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 11 Somerset Waye Hounslow. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, the front wall shall be replaced and permanently retained except at point of access and the existing vehicle access shall be enlarged to a width of  3.6m.
Condition : 9 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and conversion of garage into habitable room.
